{{Quote|The stands are packed! The crowd is crazy! The Gungans are ready with their slings!|The slingshot announcer|<ref name="ELAC">''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]''</ref>}}
'''Gungan sling painting''' was a performance art and a crowd-pleasing sport practiced by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]],<ref name="ELAC" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of intelligent [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> Individuals engaging in this practice used [[Sling/Legends|slings]] to throw off [[Gungan paint ball|balls of liquid paint]] and [[Color/Legends|color]] various objects, including dancing [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. The Gungan performers grew their natural "paint balls" in their [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="ELAC" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]&mdash;and therefore the demonstration of Gungan sling painting depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]'' to celebrate in the event's aftermath&mdash;to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> four members of the [[Gungan Sling Brigade]] made a demonstration of this art in the [[Theed Coliseum]], to honor the victory of the unified peoples of Naboo&mdash;Gungans and [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|inhabitants]]&mdash;against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]].<ref name="ELAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The painting of dancing [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with slings was one of the six activities featured in ''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]'', a children's [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2000]] by [[Lucas Learning]].<ref name="ELAC" />
